methods.name: create_club
methods.desc:
Creates a club with up to 3 initial members.
The caller is always included as a member. mbr_pay covers box storage costs.

methods.name: deposit
methods.desc: Deposits ALGO into the club treasury. Anyone can deposit.

methods.name: create_proposal
methods.desc:
Creates a spending proposal. Only club members can propose.
mbr_pay covers box storage for proposal data.

methods.name: vote
methods.desc:
Vote on a proposal. support=1 for yes, support=0 for no.
1 wallet = 1 vote. Only club members can vote.

methods.name: execute_proposal
methods.desc:
Executes an approved proposal after deadline + quorum met.
Sends funds from treasury to the proposal recipient.

methods.name: get_treasury_balance
methods.desc: Returns the treasury balance for a club.

methods.name: get_proposal_info
methods.desc: Returns (amount, votes_for, votes_against, deadline, executed) for a proposal.

sourceInfo.errorMessage: Deadline must be in the future
MBR payment must go to app
Only club members can create proposals
can only call when not creating
